blocks.label: Button / link: contact form on our website
Text: Information provided through the interest form
blocks.value: When you join our interest list or contact us, we collect what you choose to share — typically your name, email address, ZIP code, preferred Circle format, what best describes your interest, and any note you add. We may use the ZIP code you provide to identify your city or general area so we can form geographically sensible in-person Circles. If you take our "Where Am I on the Journey?" reflection, we collect your responses and the reflected result, and — only if you choose to enter it — your email address so we can send your results and a related guide.
